name: minecart-powered-brake
comment: WP-2.4b. A straight rail along x at z = 0, y = 61: a stone block at x = -1 (the end wall), a powered rail at x = 0, plain rails at x = 1..6; a lever lying on the floor at (0, 61, 1), off. The player (id 0) stands at (0.5, 61, 3.5) for use_item. A minecart (id 1) spawned at x = 5.5 with set_motion -0.3 runs onto the unpowered powered rail, whose brake halves its motion every tick and zeroes it below 0.03 (EntityMinecart.java:219-222, :262-273): it stops on the rail. At t = 60 use_item flips the lever (BlockLever.blockActivated); the powered rail turns on (metadata 9, BlockRail.onNeighborBlockChange), and the standing cart is pushed off the wall (motionX 0.02, EntityMinecart.java:402-407), then boosted by 0.06 a tick while on the rail (:396-401), and coasts down the track. rng_state, entity_state of the cart (the player's own update is WP-2.5) and the rail block every tick, block_box every 10 ticks.
